calibration.parameter_assignment: Complete native kernel count-weighted means grouped by full tensor ABI, using only six retained 4K captures. No Body measurement sets a parameter.
calibration.context_scope: These eight local kernels have no KV-context operand; context identifies assignment and validation captures, not a rule selector.
calibration.source_model_scope: Eight-layer BF16/W8A8 MoE declarations with the six retained E/K/sequence domains and explicit MC2 unfused caller.
calibration.parameter_grouping: Router casts, weight-scale casts, allocated SwiGLU/quant and expert adds share rules whenever their necessary physical ABI is identical. Matrix rules retain valid group histograms and storage capacity.
calibration.group_list_values: Source-derived force-EPLB active-prefix counts, not recorded tensor values.
calibration.validation_boundary: Native kernel means separated by retained forward populations and entire capture Body means; individual call jitter is separately retained.
calibration.mixed_held_capture_policy: The E48 K2 64K capture retains all q16/q13/q15/q12 forward populations. Only q16 receives the new atomic profile. The other three populations retain the prior prediction. GMM means are validated only within the supported q16 source-derived valid group histogram. q15 shares that local histogram but remains outside the declared atomic caller geometry and receives no new profile. q13/q12 local GMM histograms are not trained; no held value sets a parameter.
